description: This file defines the KernelMeta class, which serves as a superclass for all kernel classes in the package. It manages kernel names, metadata generation, and port handling, and references port-related classes from other modules.

classes.name: KernelMeta
classes.description: A superclass for kernel classes that manages kernel identification, port management, and metadata generation.

methods.name: unique_name(cls, kernelname)
methods.description: Generates a unique name for a kernel based on its base name, ensuring no duplicates within the class scope.

methods.name: reset_unique_names(cls)
methods.description: Resets the internal dictionary tracking used kernel names, clearing all stored names.

methods.name: None __init__(self, name, shortname, ktype, ttype, ports=None, tloc=None, disable_unique_name_id=False)
methods.description: Initializes a KernelMeta object with provided attributes such as name, shortname, type, ports, location, and an option to disable unique naming.

methods.name: _to_kbase_metadata(self)
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with base metadata for the kernel, including port metadata.

methods.name: to_metadata(self)
methods.description: Returns a complete metadata dictionary for the kernel.

methods.name: metadata(self)
methods.description: Returns a ReprDict object containing the kernel's metadata, intended for external use.

methods.name: bufferports(self)
methods.description: Property that returns a list of buffer ports associated with the kernel.

methods.name: inputbufferports(self)
methods.description: Property that returns buffer ports designated for input.

methods.name: outputbufferports(self)
methods.description: Property that returns buffer ports designated for output.

methods.name: rtpports(self)
methods.description: Property that returns RTP ports associated with the kernel.

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.pattern: /^    def __init__(self, name, shortname, ktype, ttype, ports=None, tloc=None, disable_unique_name/
ctags.signature: (self, name, shortname, ktype, ttype, ports=None, tloc=None, disable_unique_name_id=False)
